cases.title: Writing a spec in a terminal opens the floating pane with the diagram
steps: Build and start graph-manager with the fake forge as TESTING.md 'graph-manager' describes, log in, connect GitHub (token gh-good), clone octo/hello
Open Terminals, create a terminal in octo/hello and focus it

In that terminal run: mkdir -p docs/prd && printf '# Demo

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A-->B
```

| a | b |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |
' > docs/prd/demo.md
Wait 5 s; agent-browser screenshot and look at it
cases.expected: A floating pane titled with docs/prd/demo.md is open over the terminals, showing the heading 'Demo', a table and an SVG flowchart A → B

cases.title: The pane follows edits
steps: Continue from P1
In the terminal append '## Added later' to docs/prd/demo.md
Wait 5 s; screenshot
cases.expected: The pane shows 'Added later' without a page reload

cases.title: Close, chip and no reopen for old specs
steps: Continue from P2; click the pane's close button
Check the terminal pane head
Reload the page and wait 5 s
Click the 'spec demo.md' chip
cases.expected: After close the pane is gone and the terminal pane head shows a 'spec demo.md' chip; after the reload the pane does not open by itself; clicking the chip opens it

cases.title: Raw HTML in a spec is shown as text
steps: Continue from P3; append '' and '' lines to docs/prd/demo.md
Wait 5 s; agent-browser eval document.title; snapshot
cases.expected: Both lines appear as literal text in the pane; document.title is unchanged

cases.title: The specs API stays inside docs/prd
steps: With the login cookie from P1: curl /api/workspaces/github~octo~hello/specs
curl '/api/workspaces/github~octo~hello/specs/file?path=docs/prd/demo.md'
curl '...specs/file?path=../../../etc/passwd' and '?path=docs/prd/done/x.md'
cases.expected: The list has demo.md with its title 'Demo'; the file route returns its text; the two bad paths give 400

cases.title: Create PR moves the spec to docs/prd/done/
steps: In the octo/hello terminal: commit docs/prd/demo.md on main, then run graph-execution on a small task folder with --spec docs/prd/demo.md --provider fake --web (as TESTING.md describes) until it is applied
Open the run on Runs and press Create PR
git -C <fake forge bare repo of octo/hello> ls-tree -r --name-only refs/heads/<pr branch>
cases.expected: The PR is created; the commit step detail ends with 'spec → docs/prd/done/demo.md'; the branch has docs/prd/done/demo.md and not docs/prd/demo.md

cases.title: install skills installs to-spec
steps: In an empty temp folder: node packages/graph-execution/dist/cli.js install skills
cases.expected: Installed lines for run-graph, to-spec and to-tasks under .agents/skills/

cases.title: Drag and resize are kept
steps: Open the spec pane, drag it by its head and resize it from its corner
Reload the page and open it from the chip
cases.expected: It opens at the dragged position and size
